g.text: SD08 — Save and Load Game (UC10, UC11; F10; Memento)
(n1) static factory: reads version, createdAt, characterName, locationName and stateJson; invalid JSON is reported as an IOException
(n2) the current game is left untouched
(n3) reloads player, world, quests, event log and story memory into the existing objects, so observers and agents keep valid references
SD08 — Save and Load Game (UC10, UC11; F10; Memento)
(n1) one SaveSlotInfo per file: slot, character name, location and time (GameSnapshot.toSlotInfo())
